guard: Both exported stock endpoint authority schemas and their nested collections are runtime-frozen without schema changes
why: The retained actual candidate audit names both new unfrozen exports. These source mutations restore each observed root defect and separately omit recursive member freezing.

The existing audit directly imports core source, so these commands produce no compiled mutant. The runner requires original source SHA restoration and the same original audit passes after each restore.
The original aggregate audit and per-export diagnostics remain untouched. These definitions have not been executed.

mutations.name: restore mutable ENDPOINT_AUTHORITY_INPUT_SCHEMA
mutations.find: export const ENDPOINT_AUTHORITY_INPUT_SCHEMA = deepFreeze({ definitions, oneOf: [ { $ref: "#/definitions/admissionRequest" }, { $ref: "#/definitions/releaseRequest" }, { $ref: "#/definitions/checkRequest" } ] } as const);
mutations.replace: export const ENDPOINT_AUTHORITY_INPUT_SCHEMA = { definitions, oneOf: [ { $ref: "#/definitions/admissionRequest" }, { $ref: "#/definitions/releaseRequest" }, { $ref: "#/definitions/checkRequest" } ] } as const;
mutations.cell: every exported array (${arrays}) and plain-object (${objects}) collection in @cotal-ai/core is deep-frozen
